name: Mercury
description: Mercury is the smallest planet and the closest planet to the Sun.

name: Venus
description: Venus has a dense, hot atmosphere and is the second planet from the Sun.

name: Earth
description: Earth is a rocky planet with liquid water on its surface and is our home.

name: Mars
description: Mars is a rocky planet often called the Red Planet.

name: Jupiter
description: Jupiter is the largest planet and a gas giant.

name: Saturn
description: Saturn is a gas giant known for its prominent rings.

name: Uranus
description: Uranus is an ice giant that rotates on its side compared with most planets.

name: Neptune
description: Neptune is a distant ice giant and the eighth planet from the Sun.
